question: Which month was busiest in kizuki and what was the team discussing then?
sql:
WITH busiest AS (
  SELECT year_month
  FROM v_repo_activity
  WHERE repo_slug = 'kizuki'
  ORDER BY commits DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  b.year_month AS busiest_month,
  ra.commits AS commit_count,
  string_agg(DISTINCT c.conventional_type, ', ') AS commit_types,
  string_agg(c.subject, ' | ') AS commit_subjects
FROM busiest b
JOIN v_repo_activity ra ON ra.repo_slug = 'kizuki' AND ra.year_month = b.year_month
JOIN v_commit c ON c.repo_slug = 'kizuki' AND c.year_month = b.year_month
GROUP BY b.year_month, ra.commits
